title: Weak SSH Configuration
remediation: Disable weak SSH algorithms and enforce approved configuration.

title: Critical OS Security Patch Missing
remediation: Apply the vendor security update after change validation.

title: Excessive Service Account Privileges
remediation: Reduce the account to least-privilege permissions.

title: Outdated Database Package
remediation: Upgrade the affected package to a supported release.

title: Security Monitoring Agent Disabled
remediation: Restore the monitoring agent and verify telemetry ingestion.
